observations: Multiple stacks of solar panels with aluminum frames.
The cells appear to be polycrystalline based on the blue tint and square shape.
A watermark 'OG CAMBODIA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the image.
No brand names, model numbers, or technical specifications are visible on the front of the panels.

claims.claim: Lighting solution a wise choice over many alternative

risks.proof: A clear photo of the specification sticker/label on the back of a panel.
High-resolution close-up photo of the panel surface and a video of a multimeter test in sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
Close-up photo of the front of a single panel to inspect for cracks or burns.
Video showing a multimeter reading the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in daylight.
response.reason: Solar panels are priced based on their wattage (W) and brand, neither of which can be determined from the provided photo of the front of the stacks.
